subject.title: fix(config): warn when JSON5 comments are lost on config write

question: Should JSON5 comment-loss warnings intentionally bypass skipOutputLogs for machine-readable callers, provided JSON stdout remains parseable and the warning is emitted only on stderr?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes output behavior for existing automated callers; tests establish warning delivery but do not by themselves settle whether all consumers tolerate unconditional stderr warnings.

options.title: Require stderr contract proof
options.body: Keep the unconditional warning, but require focused integration evidence that JSON stdout remains parseable and successful writes retain a zero exit status.

options.title: Respect output suppression
options.body: Suppress the warning for machine-readable callers, preserving current automation behavior at the cost of silent comment loss in those flows.

recommendation.title: Require stderr contract proof
recommendation.body: Keep the unconditional warning, but require focused integration evidence that JSON stdout remains parseable and successful writes retain a zero exit status.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most directly connects this person to the central configuration write and warning behavior whose compatibility contract needs confirmation.
